parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of abstract model fields comparing as equal across different models by modifying the __eq__, __lt__, and __hash__ methods. The changes are minimal and focused on the intended fix.

issues.description: The patch introduces a new attribute access (`model`) which may not be consistent with the rest of the codebase's conventions.
